in_marathi.name: Amitaabh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amitaabh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Amitaabh is derived from Sanskrit, 'Amita' meaning infinite and 'Abh' meaning existence or source. This name signifies someone who is immeasurable or infinite in nature, often associated with the divine or cosmic entities in Hindu mythology.
